note: All six deliverables carry a methodology and none uses bare 'unit tests'. But D5 is the only deliverable producing genuinely new executable behaviour (a promotion path that creates a plan folder and writes status.json), and separate test authorship is scoped explicitly and only to D4. D1-D3 get independently written expected file lists; D5 gets nothing. The deliverable most able to hide a self-confirming test is the one exempted.
